Title: Verify that the generated QR signature is derived from a secure HMAC-SHA256 process and matches the expected length
Section: Bangla QR Code Generation - Signature Security
Preconditions: System is configured with a valid signing key and signature length in properties (e.g., qr.bangla.signingKey=test1234567890abcdef and qr.bangla.signatureLength=8)
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /generate-bangla-qr with the payload in testData. 2. Observe the response body fields 'signature' and 'crc'.

Test Data: {
  "qrVersion": "01",
  "format": "01",
  "method": "11",
  "accountType": "01",
  "merchantCategoryCode": "4111",
  "merchantId": "MERCHANT123",
  "merchantPan": "1234567890123456",
  "merchantAccountNo": "ACC123456789",
  "merchantName": "Test Merchant",
  "merchantCity": "Dhaka",
  "merchantCountryCode": "BD",
  "trxCurrencyCode": "050",
  "notificationMobileNo": "8801712345678",
  "terminalId": "TERM12345678",
  "purposeOfTrx": "Test Payment",
  "acquirerInstitutionType": "01",
  "acquirerId": "ACQ12345678",
  "merchantLogo": "logo123"
}
Expected Result: The response returns HTTP 200 OK with a 'signature' field exactly matching the last N characters of the HMAC-SHA256 hash of the signature data (where N is the configured signatureLength), and the 'crc' field is a 4-character hex string.

Title: Verify that altering any field in the request changes the generated signature, proving the signature is sensitive to input tampering

Preconditions: System is configured with a valid signing key and signature length (e.g., qr.bangla.signingKey=test1234567890abcdef and qr.bangla.signatureLength=8)
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /generate-bangla-qr with the original payload in testData. 2. Record the 'signature' value from the response. 3. Send a second POST request to /generate-bangla-qr with the modified payload (merchantName changed to 'Tampered Merchant'). 4. Compare the 'signature' value in the second response to the first.

Test Data: Original: {
  "qrVersion": "01",
  "format": "01",
  "method": "11",
  "merchantCategoryCode": "4111",
  "merchantId": "MERCHANT123",
  "merchantPan": "1234567890123456",

  "merchantName": "Test Merchant",
  "merchantCity": "Dhaka",
  "merchantCountryCode": "BD",
  "trxCurrencyCode": "050",
  "terminalId": "TERM12345678",
  "acquirerInstitutionType": "01",

Modified: {
  "merchantName": "Tampered Merchant"
